close_reason: Landed in f6f549f77 (#648), as an error per the approved proposal
description:
`rescue e in MyApp.NotThere -> ...` compiles and runs silently when no module of that name exists; the clause can never match. Elixir warns: "struct MyApp.NotThere is undefined (module MyApp.NotThere is not available or is yet to be defined)" at the clause.

Cause: `rescue_arms` (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs) turns the alias into an atom with `module_alias_atom` and matches the exception name against it. Nothing refers to the module.

Open decision: warning (Elixir) or error (what `raises:` does since fz-3sy.25). Proposal page first.
title: A rescue clause that names an undefined module warns, as Elixir does
